tests.title: matches native framemd5 and framehash text for wav and raw inputs at every channel count rate and PCM codec and stream copy
matches native frame hash text with bitexact flags, regrouping filter chains, output time and frame limits and copy
matches native guessed, unguessed and named container layouts and refuses an unnamed container mask before any output exists
refuses -hash, -format_version and atrim chains before any output exists while native accepts them
framemd5 and framehash muxers > registers output-only descriptors with the pcm_s16le default, any PCM codec and no input metadata
framemd5 and framehash muxers > writes the frame checksums header with the reference software line unless bitexact
framemd5 and framehash muxers > formats rows without a flags column and hashes regrouped packets independently of chunk boundaries and write budget
framemd5 and framehash muxers > regroups with packet sections and cumulative packet schedules
framemd5 and framehash muxers > refuses options, empty layouts and invalid parameters, framing and packets, and aborts without committing
framemd5 and framehash muxers > honors cancellation, failed writes and failed aborts

nativeComparisons.nativeInvocations: batched: one native call per input/profile writing both muxers (and all 21 codecs in the matrix)

unsupported: -hash and -format_version values (CLI parser refuses both; validate refuses any format option)
unnamed container channel masks (channelLayout '' as framecrc): refused, exit 1, native prints 'N channels (A+B)'
atrim chains (no EdgeFFmpeg atrim filter; unsupported-filter)
video, FLAC input, multiple streams, extradata and packet side data

proposedContracts.name: matches native framemd5 and framehash text for wav and raw inputs at every channel count rate and PCM codec and stream copy
proposedContracts.scope: framemd5/framehash default algorithms over raw s16le and bitexact WAV inputs, 1/2/6 channels, 8000/44100/48000 Hz, 2500 samples, 20 PCM codecs and -c copy; byte-identical text with the non-bitexact header.

proposedContracts.name: matches native frame hash text with bitexact flags, regrouping filter chains, output time and frame limits and copy
proposedContracts.scope: -bitexact, -fflags +bitexact, asetnsamples/apad chains, output -ss/-t/-frames:a, input -ss, raw and WAV -c copy (six codecs), WAV decode; byte-identical text.

proposedContracts.name: matches native guessed, unguessed and named container layouts and refuses an unnamed container mask before any output exists
proposedContracts.scope: Guessed and -guess_layout_max 0 layouts at 3/4/5/7/8 channels and named WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE masks match; unnamed masks are refused with no output.

proposedContracts.name: refuses -hash, -format_version and atrim chains before any output exists while native accepts them
proposedContracts.scope: -hash sha256/crc32, -format_version 1 and atrim chains: native accepts, EdgeFFmpeg refuses before any output exists.

notes: Rows come from planPcmFraming/framePcmPackets (PREP-FRAMING); framecrc.ts and pcm-framing.ts are untouched.
No mux.options declared: the CLI parser refuses -hash and -format_version before routing, so declaring them would not change behaviour; supporting them needs a packages/cli edit (not requested).
Unknown layout refusal applies only to an unnamed container mask; inputs without a mask under -guess_layout_max 0 print 'N channels' and match native.

Setup: sandbox Node v22.23.5 failed the bootstrap Node 24 check; Node v24.22.3 was downloaded (checksum-verified) into the scratchpad in 4 s. Bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference with --allow-unpinned-reference) took 261 s; the linked binary differs from the linux-x64 pin, as expected for a sandbox build.
Baseline before changes: typecheck, lint, boundaries pass; registry unit tests 5 files / 32 tests pass (84 s total).
Output listing side effect: 'WAV, AIFF, AU, W64, framecrc, crc, framehash, framemd5, hash, IRCAM, md5, RSO, SoX, streamhash'.
